text:
Olivia: Quick one - can we agree a compact claim flow for SI co-sell leads going into marketplace bundles? Need low friction for Q3 pilots. @Mateo @Rina
Mateo: yes. Keep it tight: 48h default claim TTL, extend to 7bd if SI marks tech_ownership=true. Single canonical CSV, weekly Friday adjudication.
Rina: add claim_priority (hot/warm/cold) and a `proof_url`. For marketplace we need `sku_lock` 5bd before publish.
Derek: from SI side: if we delivered integration code (PR link) that should auto-extend TTL. Also want `integration_repo` and `poe_contact` fields.
Olivia: agreed. Minimal CSV headers suggestion:
```
account_id,account_name,region,region_owner,sales_owner,si_org,claim_ts,claim_ttl_days,tech_ownership,claim_priority,proof_url,integration_repo,sku_lock
```
Mateo: ops can run nightly dedupe and add `confidence_pct`. If confidence>85 auto-resolve, else post to #partnerships-adjudicate.
integration-bot: scheduled job created: "si-compact-dedupe" nightly 03:00 UTC - report: https://redwood.internal/ops/reports/si-compact/2834567890 :robot_face:
Rina: RoE bullets: 1) first-claim wins unless tech_ownership=true, 2) SI evidence extends TTL, 3) marketplace SKU lock overrides open claims, 4) escalate via triage within 48h.
Olivia: pilot owners: Mateo (manifest), Rina (marketing/legal liaison), Derek (SI evidence), Olivia (final arb). Pilot = 2 weeks. Mateo will post CSV template + two sample rows by EOD.
Mateo: will do. Small ask: include `slack_thread_url` column for traceability.
Derek: I'll attach PR + demo recording links in the sample.
Olivia: thanks all - aim is less churn and faster go-to-market. Ping me if you need to move the adjudication window. :pray:
